mainEntity.name: Do you inspect septic systems on Lake James?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Lake James lots on both the Burke and McDowell sides are a regular part of my work. Tell me when you book if the lot is steep or the tank is near the water; it affects how long the inspection takes and what equipment I bring.

mainEntity.name: Where is the Burke County septic permit office?

acceptedAnswer.text: Burke County Environmental Health is at 200 Avery Avenue in Morganton, 828-764-9000. Agents can use the county's "Septic Requests for Realtors" form to ask for a copy of an existing permit or layout.

mainEntity.name: Can you do the home inspection the same day?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, through my other company, Inspect-All Home Inspections. Home inspection, septic inspection, radon and well water testing can all be scheduled for one visit.
